dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Lost to Golden Nara, but happy.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: But always losing, Aranishat doesn't want it. So Aranishat is training Ararakalari with little Nara... So that Aranishat won't be found.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Aranishat weak, little Nara don't want to play with Aranishat.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Aralila lost to Golden Nara, Aralila weak, too.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: But Golden Nara enjoyed playing with weak Aralila.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: So little Nara will play with Aranishat and Aralila, too.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Well... Aranishat is right. Then, let's visit little Nara together.
